ModMetaData.name: RimSiege
ModMetaData.author: BenFD
ModMetaData.description:
Medieval sieges that actually siege.
Vanilla sieges are mortars in a field. In RimSiege the enemy shows up with a plan: they demand a tribute first, and if you refuse they set up a war camp (banner, campfire, tents, stakes) and build their siege engines on site.
[b]What they bring[/b] - A battering ram for your gate. Crewed: kill the pushers and it stops. Double gates wont save you, it keeps going. - Or a siege tower that goes OVER your walls. The wall stays intact, the whole army climbs it one by one. - Tribes come lighter: a log ram carried by four warriors that swings into your gate, or a ladder they lean on your rampart. No trebuchets, no sappers. - Trebuchet batteries and ballistas (with Medieval Overhaul), manned and reloaded from an ammo pile at the camp. - Sappers planting petards on a second wall while the ram hits the front. Pincer assaults. - A captain guarded by two bodyguards, in a gilded helm if you run Medieval Overhaul. Kill him before the breach and the whole siege routs - they even retreat back over their tower. - Capture the captain alive and his house sends a truce party to ransom him back, silver in hand. Execute him or let him rot and they swear a vendetta: the next siege comes sooner, angrier, and without an ultimatum.
Everything scales with threat points: small war parties just camp and charge on foot, late game sieges bring the full siege train. Settings page to tune all the thresholds.
Medieval houses bring the wheeled engines, tribes carry theirs. Gun era factions (pirates, outlanders) still demand tribute and set up camp, but they assault on foot for now - no wooden rams for guys with rifles.
[b]Counterplay[/b]: pay the tribute, raid the camp before the engines are built, kill the crews, burn the wooden engines, steal the trebuchet boulders, snipe the captain - or take him alive and sell him back to his own house.
[b]Medieval Overhaul optional but recommended[/b]: its noble houses, trebuchets, ballistas, banners and gilded helms plug right in (all by DankPyon). Camping Tent optional (adds tents to the camp).
Modders: RimSiege.SiegeApi lets your mod run a siege with its own army.
Siege tower and battering ram art by Tom. Siege ladder based on Deon's Deep And Deeper - Ladder retexture, used with permission.
BenFD
